text:
Eli: Heads-up — running into a parity gap in the Ruby SDK.
Eli: Repro: start a streaming generate, then rotate API token mid-stream; the client raises EOF/connection reset instead of refreshing the token and retrying the chunk.
Eli: Minimal repro attached below; happens on v1.1.0 and main.
Eli: ```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(token: ENV['REDWOOD_TOKEN'])
client.chat.stream(...) do |chunk|
  puts chunk
end
# rotate token here -> EOF
```
Sam: Oof, that sounds bad. Is this only streaming or non-streaming too?
Eli: Only streaming so far. Non-streaming retries ok (we use the standard retry middleware) — streaming path bypasses it.
Marisa: @Eli can you open a tiny maintenance PR with a failing test? I can pick it up if it's small. Link the repro in the PR.
Eli: Yup created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/762 — includes repro and suggested patch to re-run handshake when 401 mid-stream.
devex-bot: CI started for PR #762 — matrix: ruby-3.1,ruby-3.2,linux,macos,windows
ci-bot: build failing on windows job: bundler install flake, error: 'The system cannot find the path specified'
ci-bot: ```
Errno::ENOENT: No such file or directory @ rb_sysopen - tmp/gemspec.lock
```
Marisa: Hmm windows flake again, will re-run. For a short-term workaround, recommend adding server-side retry for 429 + proper 401 handshake.
Sam: :+1: Also let's add a smoke to the sampleapp quickstart to exercise token rotation (low-cost test).
Eli: Thanks all — tagging @Marisa for review. If CI keeps flaking on windows we'll gate the test to non-windows.
Marisa: Got it, I'll review tomorrow and try to reproduce locally on a windows runner. Thanks for the clear repro.
